body.purpose: Compact fields, tabs, toolbar actions, and supporting copy.

components.name: Top Bar Action
components.description: Global undo, redo, save, and export actions in the fixed ink top bar.
components.css: .ds-topbar-action { color: #e5e7eb; background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; padding: 7px 10px; font: 400 12px 'Segoe UI', 'Malgun Gothic', sans-serif; } .ds-topbar-action:hover, .ds-topbar-action:focus-visible { background: #273449; border-color: #3b4a60; } .ds-topbar-action:active { background: #1f2937; }

components.name: Tool Rail Action
components.description: Text-only editing tool inside the narrow left rail.
components.css: .ds-toolrail-action { width: 68px; color: #cbd5e1; background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; padding: 9px 7px; text-align: left; font: 400 12px 'Segoe UI', 'Malgun Gothic', sans-serif; } .ds-toolrail-action:hover, .ds-toolrail-action:focus-visible { color: #ffffff; background: #1f2937; border-color: #334155; } .ds-toolrail-action:active { background: #273449; }

components.name: Selected Tool Rail Action
components.description: Checked editing tool with explicit blue selection treatment.
components.css: .ds-toolrail-action-selected { width: 68px; color: #ffffff; background: #2563eb; border: 1px solid #60a5fa; border-radius: 6px; padding: 9px 7px; text-align: left; font: 400 12px 'Segoe UI', 'Malgun Gothic', sans-serif; } .ds-toolrail-action-selected:hover, .ds-toolrail-action-selected:focus-visible { border-color: #93c5fd; } .ds-toolrail-action-selected:active { background: #1d4ed8; }

components.name: Inspector Button
components.description: Compact bold action used throughout inspector rows and save controls.
components.css: .ds-inspector-button { color: #111827; background: #e8edf5; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 10px; font: 700 12px 'Segoe UI', 'Malgun Gothic', sans-serif; } .ds-inspector-button:hover, .ds-inspector-button:focus-visible { background: #dbeafe; border-color: #60a5fa; } .ds-inspector-button:active { background: #bfdbfe; }

components.name: Inspector Field
components.description: White editable field on the light inspector surface.
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: #334155; font: 600 12px 'Segoe UI', 'Malgun Gothic', sans-serif; } .ds-inspector-field { color: #111827; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 6px; padding: 6px; font: 400 12px 'Segoe UI', 'Malgun Gothic', sans-serif; } .ds-inspector-field:hover { border-color: #94a3b8; } .ds-inspector-field:focus-visible { border-color: #2563eb; outline: none; } .ds-inspector-field:active { border-color: #2563eb; } .ds-inspector-field::selection { background: #bfdbfe; }

components.name: Inspector Tabs
components.description: Implemented OCR, inpainting, translation, and editor-settings tab pattern.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; align-items: end; border-bottom: 1px solid #d8dee9; } .ds-tab { color: #475569; background: #e8edf5; border: 1px solid #d8dee9; border-bottom: 0; border-radius: 6px 6px 0 0; padding: 7px 12px; margin-right: 2px; font: 400 12px 'Segoe UI', 'Malgun Gothic', sans-serif; } .ds-tab:hover, .ds-tab:focus-visible { border-color: #60a5fa; } .ds-tab:active { background: #dbeafe; } .ds-tab-selected { color: #1d4ed8; background: #ffffff; }

components.name: Zoom Button
components.description: Compact dark control for pan, zoom, fit, and actual-size actions.
components.css: .ds-zoom-button { min-height: 20px; color: #f8fafc; background: #374151; border: 1px solid #4b5563; border-radius: 4px; padding: 4px 10px; font: 400 12px 'Segoe UI', 'Malgun Gothic', sans-serif; } .ds-zoom-button:hover, .ds-zoom-button:focus-visible { background: #475569; border-color: #93c5fd; } .ds-zoom-button:active { background: #2563eb; }

components.name: Status Callout
components.description: Persistent textual feedback below the inspector scroll area.
components.css: .ds-status { color: #1e3a8a; background: #eef6ff; border: 1px solid #bfdbfe; border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px; font: 500 12px 'Segoe UI', 'Malgun Gothic', sans-serif; } .ds-status:hover { border-color: #60a5fa; } .ds-status:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2563eb; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-status:active { background: #dbeafe; }

narrative.overview:
The advanced editor is a native Windows Operate surface: a focused workbench where the manga page remains visually dominant and every editing decision stays close to its consequence. Its Tubik/Ribbet pattern is structural rather than decorative—an ink-colored tool rail and minimal top action bar frame a light inspector, while the central canvas holds the user's attention.

The world is practical, dense, and immediate. Dark chrome separates global tools from editable content; pale controls support long inspection sessions; blue appears only for active selection, focus, and direct manipulation. Standard Qt behavior, keyboard shortcuts, tooltips, dialogs, scrollbars, and established editing behavior remain intact.
keyCharacteristics: One-direction tool discovery from the left rail into the adjacent inspector
Dark ink chrome against a light, compact inspector
Blue state feedback paired with checked, focused, selected, or textual cues
Restrained six-pixel controls and standard Qt affordances

rules.name: The Blue Means State Rule
rules.body: Blue marks selection, focus, checked tools, or direct manipulation; it is not ambient decoration.

rules.name: The Ink Frames Work Rule
rules.body: Dark ink belongs to the tool rail, top action bar, and canvas controls; editable inspector content stays on light paper.

rules.name: The System UI Rule
rules.body: Keep Segoe UI and Malgun Gothic for editor chrome; do not introduce web fonts or editorial display faces into the native workspace.

rules.name: The Left-to-Canvas Rule
rules.body: A user chooses a tool on the far left, changes its values immediately beside it, and verifies the result in the center without crossing the canvas.

rules.name: The Flat Workbench Rule
rules.body: Resting editor surfaces stay flat; hierarchy comes from adjacency, tone, and borders rather than floating cards.

dos: Do keep the advanced editor canvas-first and preserve the left rail → inspector → canvas reading order.
Do reserve blue for active, focused, selected, or directly manipulated state.
Do preserve native Qt keyboard shortcuts, tooltips, dialogs, scrollbars, focus behavior, and existing editing behavior.
Do keep user-facing editor labels in clear Korean and verify that they render correctly on Windows.
Do pair state color with checked controls, focus edges, selection handles, labels, or status text.
Do keep inspector controls compact enough for repeated OCR, text, font, mask, inpainting, and translation work.
donts: Don't move the inspector across the canvas or split related tool choice and settings between opposite sides.
Don't add gradients, decorative shadows, floating cards, oversized headings, or ornamental chrome.
Don't use Operational Blue as a broad background or decorative accent unrelated to state.
Don't replace the system font stack or imitate browser UI patterns that weaken standard Qt affordances.
Don't document or introduce components that are not present in the native editor.
